instruction.common: Each segment opens with a 説 (hypothesis) title card; keep 説 as 「說」 and render the title cards consistently.
instruction.pre_pass: List every 説 title card in proper_nouns with its exact on-screen wording.
instruction.translate: The studio panel's commentary is overlaid on VTR footage; keep the panel's quips short.
instruction.refine: Keep the narrator's deadpan tone; do not add exclamation marks to narration.
instruction.glossary_check: Panelist names follow fixed_glossary even when the on-screen caption abbreviates them.
